status-1.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production UI status-effect icons for a dark fantasy 2D action RPG battle HUD (shown at 18-24px next to a timer). Image1 is the existing growth-tree icon atlas of this game: match its painterly dark-metal style, glowing accents, dark outlines and readability at tiny size; never copy its icons. Create ONE transparent RGBA square image with exactly SIX separate round icon badges in an invisible 3 columns x 2 rows grid (row 1 cells 1-3, row 2 cells 4-6). Each badge is a small circular dark iron disc with a thin colored rim and ONE bold, simple, high-contrast symbol in the middle (thick shapes, no fine detail), centered in its own cell with wide transparent margins, never touching each other or the canvas edge, filling about 60% of its cell. Actual alpha transparency, no background, no text, no letters, no numbers, no characters, no faces. ICONS: (1) a fierce orange-red flame (BURN, orange rim), (2) a pale-blue ice crystal snowflake (FROST, ice-blue rim), (3) a violet hollow eye inside a dripping hex sigil (CURSE, violet rim), (4) a sickly green dripping acid drop eating a metal plate (CORRODE, green rim), (5) a heavy chained padlock over a crossed-out sword (SEAL / skills locked, steel-grey and deep purple rim), (6) a radiant white-gold sunburst with a small sword (PURIFIED / cleansed buff, golden rim)
